summary: 23-year-old hunter separated from his party on Coffee Pot road became stranded on a cliff in Glenwood Canyon about 0.6 miles from the Bair Ranch rest area on I-70 and triggered a Garmin SOS; GSAR located him and guided him down to Tie Gulch, where he was reunited with his party
location: Glenwood Canyon near Bair Ranch rest area, I-70
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue (Garfield County Sheriff's Office)
notes: 6-member GSAR team; snow mixed with rain, upper 20s at the time of rescue.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Garfield County, Colorado, United States)
